title: Rehab-Immersive: a framework to support the development of virtual reality applications in upper limb rehabilitation
description: Virtual reality framework for upper limb rehabilitation in patients with spinal cord injury, including a demonstrator application of the Box and Block Test for Oculus Quest 2 with kinematics tracking and patient-specific customisation. This work was supported by the Spanish Ministry of Science, Innovation and Universities / Agencia Estatal de Investigación under grant PID2020-117361RB-C21 (project REHAB-IMMERSIVE), and carried out by the AIR Research Group of the Universidad de Castilla-La Mancha in collaboration with the Hospital Nacional de Parapléjicos (Toledo, Spain).
